anomalies.obs: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet the IIS2MDCTR magnetometer U8 has its SCL/SPC pin (1) labelled I2C4_SCL_NAVC while its SDA/SDI/SDO pin (5) is labelled I2C1_SDA_NAVC. The two lines of the same I2C device therefore sit on two different buses. The NAVC MCU is an STM32F405RGTx, which has only I2C1/I2C2/I2C3 (no I2C4), and the NAVC sheet provides pull-ups only on I2C1/I2C2/I2C3, so the net I2C4_SCL_NAVC has neither a driver nor a pull-up. Every other NAVC sensor (BMI088, TMP100, MPRLS, 24CW1280 EEPROM) is on I2C1.
anomalies.expected: Both SCL and SDA of U8 must be on the same NAVC I2C sensor bus (I2C1, like all other NAVC I2C peripherals), so the magnetometer can be clocked and addressed at 0x1E.

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals sheet: U8 IIS2MDCTR pin1 SCL/SPC -> I2C4_SCL_NAVC ; pin5 SDA/SDI/SDO -> I2C1_SDA_NAVC ; note 'I2C address: 0x1E'
NAVC sheet: NAVC1 = STM32F405RGTx; I2C pull-ups R28-R31 only on I2C1/I2C3; note 'I2C2_NAVC already pulled up by I2C1_FCC resistors!' (no I2C4)
Magnetometer | NAVCPeripherals | ST IIS2MDCTR, I2C addr 0x1E ... Navigation Computer MCU | NAVC1 | STM32F405RGTx (Cortex-M4)

anomalies.impact: The magnetometer's clock line is left floating (no MCU SCL, no pull-up), so the device is never clocked and cannot be addressed; heading/magnetometer data is lost, degrading or breaking the Kalman-filter state estimate.

parsed.summary: The drawing is largely consistent with the specification (correct shunt, inductor, divider, LDO, addresses, crystals, dual-MCU split, and the documented barometer RESET/EOC swap), but the IIS2MDCTR magnetometer U8 has its SCL routed to a non-existent bus (I2C4_SCL_NAVC) while its SDA is on I2C1, leaving the clock line unconnected and the magnetometer inoperable.
